item.title: Lake Mills advances to state duals
item.description: Lake Mills hosted regional duals Tuesday night and punched its ticket to the 2026 State Dual Tournament this weekend in Coralville.

item.title: Moving to Charlotte? Why the Right Local Team Can Make Your Move Feel Effortless
item.description: Charlotte has a way of sneaking up on people.

item.title: Car Accident Attorneys and the Legal Process After a Collision
item.description: After a motor vehicle accident, victims are often forced to deal with medical treatment, vehicle repairs, and insurance claims at the same time.

item.title: Orlando Chapter 7 Bankruptcy Lawyer: Guiding You Through Financial Relief
item.description: Financial difficulties can happen to anyone, whether due to medical bills, job loss, or overwhelming credit card debt.

item.title: Merilynn Kay Linde
item.description: Merilynn Kay Linde, 80, of Albert Lea, passed away peacefully on February 2, 2026.

item.title: Rosella (Rosie) Roberts Simon
item.description: Rosella (Rosie) Roberts Simon passed away Friday, Jan. 30, at age 95. Services are planned for Saturday, April 25, at 1:00 pm at Bridge Community Church in Albert Lea. Complete obituary to follow

item.title: Garrett Gene Hatle
item.description: Garrett Gene Hatle, 79, passed away on Wednesday, February 4, 2026. A memorial service will be held on Thursday, February 12, 2026 at the Good Samaritan Society Chapel at 1:30 PM with visitation to be held for an hour prior to the service. Reverend Kent Otterman will be officiating.

item.title: Chamber announces 21st annual Agriculture Luncheon and Farm Family nominations
item.description: The Albert Lea-Freeborn County Chamber of Commerce Agricultural Committee on Thursday announced that the 21st annual Agriculture Luncheon is scheduled for noon to 1:30 p.m. March 24 at the Fairlane Building at the Freeborn County Fairgrounds.

item.title: Lunch and Learn event to feature area photographer
item.description: The Albert Lea Public Library invites the public to Bring Your Own Lunch and Learn on Feb. 12 with the program, “Spring Migration Bird Watching” presented by Bryce Gaudian.

item.title: Cast your votes to help MnDOT name eight more snowplows
item.description: Voting on a new list of finalists begins today in the Minnesota Department of Transportation’s latest Name a Snowplow contest. The top eight vote-getters will become new MnDOT snowplow names, one new name for each MnDOT district.
